biography:
I am a skilled and knowledgeable pre-construction manager with more than 12 years of budgeting, cost estimate development, and project management experience in the private and Government sectors. Recognized for demonstrating a natural aptitude for cultivating highly-functional relationships with diverse team members, as well as for managing multiple projects simultaneously, I have a verifiable history of contributing directly to organizational growth and expansion throughout my career. 

My professional focal points include: construction management, budgeting, contract negotiations, relationship building, value engineering, and project estimating. Delivering superior administration on the latter areas of expertise requires utilization of effective communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, as well as business acumen and project management expertise.

Currently, I am the Construction Estimator with the Alliance Residential Company in San Francisco, California. In this role, I help manage land acquisition budgeting, due diligence, and budget update for capital request approval. I also communicate with General Contractor Pre-Construction Groups on cost information. Additionally, I identify cost trends to assist management in cost reduction and process improvement efforts.

Colleagues describe me as a progressive, driven, down-to-earth, strategic, and analytical expert who can be relied on to offer superior solutions that deliver results on time and under budget.

I am interested in contacting former colleagues and managers, as well as other professionals in my field. Feel free to contact me through this profile if you wish to connect.
